_rule: An IndexMeasure (elohim_epr_rea::index) and a Manifest EPR; it deserializes straight into the protocol type, CIDs spelled as strings. chunkRule is atom_cid (canonical dag-cbor) of _chunk_rule, which holds only the rule's values: a non-sectioned file is cut into line windows of max_chunk_bytes, a measure of its own and not the lexical passage window (discovery.passage_window_bytes). foldLag omits sense and source because an absent sense is a ceiling and an absent source is declared (Bound's one encoding per meaning). The measure's method CID is IndexMeasure::cid() over the typed value; the underscore keys are not part of it.
_surfaces: surfaces.paths are gitignore-style globs over repository-relative paths: a file is admitted when an include matches and no `!` negation does (negations always win; nothing re-includes). `**` spans directories, `*` stays within one component, a leading dot needs no literal, a trailing `/**` means everything beneath. The contract's discovery.exclude_directories and the private-chain floor (.eprfs/status/recall/**, **/worktrees/**) apply on top, and on a git checkout the candidates are the tracked files (git ls-files): ignored and untracked derived state is not declared source. The fold covers the authority layer (prose, scripts, stories, declarations), not seed data, generated output or code nobody asks about in words.
_retention: Retention has no fold-count period (elohim_epr::measure::Period is wall-clock), so 'demote at the next fold' is declared as a zero delay: a removed or superseded file is demoted by the first fold that observes it, never deleted.
